## Lite-Scope Awareness

<!-- OpenCohost Lite is a specific, intentional scope. Before submitting, please check:

  IN SCOPE (Lite ships these):
    - Cohost mode: Kira AI agenda, topic tracking, anti-leak guardrails
    - Local LLM via Ollama (model catalog + tier switching)
    - Edge-TTS voice synthesis (Microsoft cloud — Kira's spoken text is sent to Microsoft for synthesis; everything else stays on your machine)
    - Optional offline voice via Piper TTS (`local-tts` extra)
    - Smart Aggregator (viewer chat routing)
    - OBS avatar + music bed integration

  OUT OF SCOPE for Lite (not planned):
    - Voice cloning or custom TTS model training
    - Stream administration / moderation automation
    - Cloud LLM backends (no OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
    - Mobile or browser-based clients

  Does your request fit within the Lite scope above? -->
